notes.title: January 8th 2025 Update
notes.notes:
Patch Note:

1.New system: Added the CrystalCore system, in 4 round, you can pick 1 of 3 CrystalCores to strength your team.

2.New system: Added the tomb system, when a hero die, he will turn into a tomb. The tomb can’t be covered. After one round, this hero will come back to your hands  

3.Fix some bugs

notes.title: July 18th 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Patch Note:

1.Optimized the logic of playing cards: now you can play cards continuously!
2.Optimized the logic of Effects: now the Effects playing without interrupt.
3.Uniformed ATK/DEF/HEL of hovering and normal cards in battle.
4.Added new cards:
(1)Added 8 new Heroes with new skills;
(2)Added 4 new Tech cards;
(3)Added 25 new Servant.
5.Fixed some bugs:
(1)Pressing out cards do not work
(2)When roles’ HEL= 0 on playing turn, he is not die.
(3)Ending volume is too loud.
(4)Game lagging when too many buffs work
(5)Lionheart Researcher’s Bind card working faildly
6.Buff working principle redefined:
(1)Multispell (new): when attack, you can attack the same target again
(2)Huntdown (new): when kill one role, you can attack new target again
(3)Priority: Counterattack > Overload > Pursuit

notes.title: July 4th 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Patch Note:

1.Chaos Mode adjusted: updated the distribution of map, adjusted the die effect of the card

2.New system: Achieves now have been opened, there have 50 achieves you can get ( include 2 hidden achieves).

3.Card adjusted: The move cards have been removed, now you can click the card and spend Electron to move.

4.Effect calibrate: open deck effect.

5.Fix some bugs

notes.title: May 31th 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Patch Note:

1.New mode has been added: Chaos Mode; Now you can battle with 2 gamers at the same time.

2.Balanced adjustment: we slightly downgraded the growth of some Heroes; And upgraded the attributes of some Servants.

3.Fix some bugs.

4.Add the tips of buff keywords: now you can see what they mean.

notes.title: April 24th 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Patch Note:

1.Deck systerm has been improved

2.Game sound effects have been added and improved.

3.In PVE mode, AI will always play monster card so that keep his zone not empty.

4.In PVE mode, monsters' attributes have been adjusted, now their strength rises more gently

5.The monsters can also inherit their attribute improvements now.

6.You know, we solved some bugs.

notes.title: April 9th 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Patch Note:

1.In PVE mode, heroes can now inherit buffs, equipment, and attributes. That means you can train your hero without worrying about him being reset next turn!

2.Added resolution selection, now you can adjust game resolution.

3.Optimized the AI algorithm of PVE Mode, now the AI is more powerful and will decide its own way of playing cards depending on the situation: show characters or attribute increase etc.

4.In PVE mode, a new relic store has been added, where you can buy relics to get permanent enhancements.

5.Game effects have been further improved, added the line effects, monster UI effects etc.

6.Game sound effects have been added.

7. Some bugs have been solved.
